name: rxappkit-bindings
description: RxAppKit binding conventions for coding agents. Stops the PublishRelay+@objc antipattern, the hand-rolled NSXxxDataSource antipattern, and surfaces the @dynamicMemberLookup synthesis on every HasTargeAction conformer (NSControl, NSMenuItem, NSToolbarItem, NSGestureRecognizer, NSColorPanel).

interface.longDescription: Teaches the canonical RxAppKit binding patterns: rx.click, rx.<property>, rx.nodes and rx.items instead of PublishRelay plus @objc plumbing or hand-rolled NSTableViewDataSource / NSOutlineViewDataSource / NSCollectionViewDataSource / NSBrowserDelegate, and the @dynamicMemberLookup properties every HasTargeAction conformer gets for free.
defaultPrompt: Bind this NSOutlineView to an Rx stream
Drive this view's isHidden from an observable
